title: AgeCheck NotStarted/Started is a two-variant started flag beside AgeVerification params
trigger: user opens the age bot link (start_age_check) then the server re-sends the same params
effect: none today: Started survives only while params are equal, and any params change silently resets it by hand in set_age_verification
fix: fold into the verification stage: Needed{params} / BotOpened{params}, reset by its own transition

title: story_search_send_failed overwrites a Loading page with Failed without checking the request
trigger: search page A is in flight (PageFetch::Loading{A}); a second page send fails locally and calls story_search_send_failed
effect: stage becomes Failed while A is still out; A's answer is then dropped by search_waiting_for (page no longer waits for A), so the page that arrived is lost and Retry re-asks it
fix: fail only when page is Idle (the send that failed), or hold the request in the failure

title: self-destruct and auto-delete countdowns are stamped with wall-clock SystemTime at parse time
trigger: a message with a self-destruct or auto-delete timer is parsed, then the system clock jumps (NTP step, manual change, sleep/resume with a skewed clock)
effect: the badge/chip shows a wrong remaining time (stuck at full or 0) until the message is parsed again; a hidden clock inside the parser also defeats the manual-clock rule for tests
fix: stamp with the app's monotonic/manual clock (Instant) when the message is applied to the session, not in the parser

title: parse_error early-return branches drop limit_hint, premium_limit and database_detail
trigger: a server message that matches a story/sign-in/AI-compose/collectible class also matches a folder-limit or premium-limit message
effect: the error carries the first class only; the limit hint/premium upsell for the same message is None, so the matching dialog is not offered
fix: build one TdError and set class by precedence instead of four copies of the struct literal

title: Api::load stops at the first library that lacks the sticker symbols instead of trying the next candidate
trigger: an older quillvideo library sits first in QUILL_VIDEO_LIB or the exe dir while a newer one is in vendor/ffmpeg/prefix
effect: the `?`/map_err inside the candidate loop returns the symbol error immediately, so the in-process WebM decoder is reported unavailable for 30 s and falls back to the ffmpeg subprocess
fix: record the symbol error in `last` and continue to the next candidate
